run_multi_view_dataset: run a multi-view dataset test by sampling random data and projecting 3D bounding box corners onto images
draw_corners: draw 3D bounding box corners projected onto a 2D image using a camera projection matrix
test_scannet_multi_view_dataset: test the ScanNet multi-view dataset by loading annotations and rendering 3D bounding boxes on images
test_sunrgbd_multi_view_dataset: test the SUNRGBD multi-view dataset with random flip augmentation and 3D bounding box visualization
test_nuscenes_multi_view_dataset: test the NuScenes multi-view dataset with 6 camera views and LiDAR-based 3D bounding boxes
